dedupe_keys.name: input files for synthetic low voltage distribution grid generation using gridcreator

description: Input Files for Synthetic Low-Voltage Distribution Grid Generation using GridCreator is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Gunter Grimm, Matthias Behr (University of Freiburg). Difference to previous version: mastr_values_per_plz.csv now contains additional column "Solar_Capacity_Relative_Anteil" to allow for change in distribution of PV units in GridCreator. This dataset contains the necessary input files to create synthetic yet realistic low-voltage distribution grids for German grid areas using the open-source GridCreator Toolbox (INATECH-CIG/GridCreator: Automatically generate distribution networks based on open data). Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is GPL-3.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
